history.summary: Mixed-use 1BR right on top of Potong Pasir MRT (170m) with a 213-transaction liquid base and PSF ($1,689) well below the URA median of $1,962. Excellent location and entry price but only 2.4%/yr appreciation and the niche 1BR tenant/buyer pool cap upside.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $1,689 sits ~14% under the $1,962.5 URA median on a deep 213-txn series, and integrated MRT/retail access is a genuine rental draw. But 99LH appreciation is a soft 2.45%/yr, the 1BR/592sqft format is the most cyclical segment, and at $1M the resale pool is investors/singles only.
red_flags: 1BR niche segment with shallow owner-occupier demand
Soft 2.45%/yr URA appreciation despite prime transit location
Mixed-use developments carry higher maintenance and commercial-noise exposure
catalysts: Direct NE-line connectivity 170m to Potong Pasir MRT
Below-median entry PSF leaves room to the $1,962 median
Integrated retail mall supports rental occupancy

history.summary: RCR (D13) MRT-integrated 1BR whose cheap-vs-peers signal is verified real against deep transaction data — the standout of this batch on a value basis.
history.rating_rationale: The algo's value signal (-15.1% age-adj, -14.4% vs same-size cohort over a healthy 29-txn cohort, score 804) checks out against the web: The Poiz averaged S$2,036-2,071 psf over the trailing 6-12 months across a deep 213-transaction base, and a comparable 592-sqft 1BR is also listed at ~S$1,655 psf. This unit at S$1,689 psf is a genuine ~15-18% discount to project pricing (the true 1BR-specific gap is narrower than the pooled average since larger units lift it, but the -14.4% same-cohort figure rests on real depth). The unit sits directly atop Potong Pasir MRT (NE10) with Poiz Centre retail at the doorstep — durable rental and resale demand in a region (RCR ~+3.5% realized fwd) that backtests better than CCR. Trailing CAGR is only 2.45% so the case is value, not momentum, which is exactly what the v3.4 priors reward.
red_flags: Resident reviews cite poor sound insulation and frequently broken escalators/doors at the integrated podium
99-yr leasehold from 2014/2018 TOP — lease decay clock running on a small unit
catalysts: Direct integration with Potong Pasir MRT (NE10) and Poiz Centre retail — built-in tenant pool
RCR location with NEL access to Dhoby Ghaut/CBD supports stable resale liquidity
